# Cncf Boundary Reviewer

Review Boundary using its official documentation and repository in the Provisioning / Security &amp; Compliance category. Boundary is designed to grant access to critical systems using the principle of least privilege, solving challenges organizations encounter when users need to securely access applications and machines.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
